{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with sentinel value '999,999.99'
mask_sentinel = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Check the status of these rows
sentinel_status = df.loc[mask_sentinel, 'status'].unique()

print(f"Status of rows with sentinel revenue '999,999.99': {sentinel_status}")"}
